name: v51_range_volume_exhaustion_reversal
hypothesis: Large recent returns on unusual volume and wide range can mark short-horizon exhaustion; use realized range and volume rather than the crowded close/open reversal parent.
expression: 0.40 * rank(-1 * ts_rank(returns * (volume / adv20), 10)) + 0.30 * rank(-1 * ts_rank((high - low) / close, 10)) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_60_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 60), industry)
notes: Unit-clean technical exhaustion probe; no close/open, option, news, social, graph, or accounting fields.

name: v51_vwap_close_acceptance_momentum
hypothesis: Closing above VWAP on improving relative volume may indicate accepted demand pressure rather than temporary open-close reversal.
expression: 0.40 * rank(ts_rank((close - vwap) / close, 20)) + 0.25 * rank(ts_rank(volume / adv20, 20)) + 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_60_days_spy, 60), industry)
notes: Tests VWAP acceptance/continuation; compare carefully against close/open ACTIVE names.

name: v51_vwap_close_pressure_reversal
hypothesis: A close far above VWAP may also be temporary late-session pressure; the opposite sign tests reversal without using open.
expression: 0.40 * rank(-1 * ts_rank((close - vwap) / close, 20)) + 0.25 * rank(ts_rank(volume / adv20, 20)) + 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (unsystematic_risk_last_60_days - unsystematic_risk_last_360_days), 60), industry)
notes: Sign control for VWAP pressure; only one of continuation/reversal should be considered.

name: v51_close_location_breakout_acceptance
hypothesis: Closing near the daily high within a range, confirmed by relative volume and low beta slope, may capture range breakout acceptance.
expression: 0.40 * rank(ts_rank((close - low) / (high - low + 0.01 * close), 20)) + 0.25 * rank(ts_rank(volume / adv20, 20)) + 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_60_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 60), industry)
notes: Uses intraday close location but not close/open ratio.

name: v51_close_location_late_pressure_reversal
hypothesis: Closing near the high can also be late-session pressure that mean-reverts; this is the sign-control pair for close-location acceptance.
expression: 0.40 * rank(-1 * ts_rank((close - low) / (high - low + 0.01 * close), 20)) + 0.25 * rank(ts_rank(volume / adv20, 20)) + 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_60_days_spy, 60), industry)
notes: Mean-reversion sign control for close-location pressure.

name: v51_trend_quality_low_range
hypothesis: Moderate positive trend with low realized return volatility and compressed range may be more robust than raw momentum.
expression: 0.40 * rank(ts_rank(ts_mean(returns, 20) / (ts_std_dev(returns, 60) + 0.01), 60)) + 0.30 * rank(-1 * ts_rank((high - low) / close, 20)) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 60), industry)
notes: Clean trend-quality structure; watch momentum/reversal correlation.

name: v51_short_trend_volume_reversal
hypothesis: Short positive trend on high relative volume may be overreaction; test a return/volume reversal without open-close information.
expression: 0.40 * rank(-1 * ts_rank(ts_mean(returns, 5) / (ts_std_dev(returns, 20) + 0.01), 60)) + 0.30 * rank(ts_rank(volume / adv20, 10)) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 60), industry)
notes: Potentially high turnover; decay 24 should smooth updates.

name: v51_price_volume_corr_reversal
hypothesis: Strong recent price-volume correlation can indicate crowded participation; the reversal sign may diversify from ordinary momentum.
expression: 0.45 * rank(-1 * ts_rank(ts_corr(rank(close), rank(volume), 20), 60)) + 0.25 * rank(-1 * ts_rank((high - low) / close, 20)) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (systematic_risk_last_60_days - systematic_risk_last_360_days), 60), industry)
notes: Formulaic price-volume correlation probe; no direct return reversal.

name: v51_return_volume_corr_momentum
hypothesis: Positive correlation between returns and relative volume may reflect confirmed accumulation when paired with low market correlation.
expression: 0.45 * rank(ts_rank(ts_corr(returns, volume / adv20, 20), 60)) + 0.25 * rank(-1 * ts_rank((high - low) / close, 20)) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_60_days_spy, 60), industry)
notes: Return-volume correlation sign pair with the previous candidate.

name: v51_low_vol_vwap_stability
hypothesis: Low realized volatility plus small VWAP dislocation may capture stable demand and avoid event/accounting clusters.
expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_std_dev(returns, 20), 60), industry) + 0.30 * rank(-1 * ts_rank(abs(close / vwap - 1), 20)) + 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 60), industry)
notes: Low-volatility/stability probe; likely weak but low overlap if it works.
